title: Eventually small extension-closed derived alpha-compact classes
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian category A [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with derived coproducts [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts], there is a regular beta in universe v such that for every regular alpha at least beta, the canonical alpha-compact class [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object] in D(A) is essentially v-small and closed under extensions.

source.place: Krause (2001), Lemma 5 and Theorem B; Localization theory 6.3; Neeman Theorem 0.2.

proof.text: Choose the small perfect generating class G and its regular rank beta.
For regular alpha at least beta, monotonicity makes G alpha-small without changing its G4 or generation property. Apply the generic smallness and extension-closure theorem to the canonical class.
